items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: The essential aspect of ZON, which are of the phase of Vav and a point, are attached to the Yesod and Atara of Arich Anpin; and the Yesod of Arich Anpin is clothed within the Yesods of Aba and Ima. (Page 923, Item 98).
